sn46.21:1.1: Then a certain bhikkhu approached the Blessed One…. Sitting to one side, that bhikkhu said to the Blessed One:
sn46.21:2.1: “Venerable sir, it is said, ‘factors of enlightenment, factors of enlightenment.’
sn46.21:2.2: In what sense are they called factors of enlightenment?”
sn46.21:2.3: “They lead to enlightenment, bhikkhu, therefore they are called factors of enlightenment.
sn46.21:2.4: Here, bhikkhu, one develops the enlightenment factor of mindfulness, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release….
sn46.21:2.5: One develops the enlightenment factor of equanimity, which is based upon seclusion, dispassion, and cessation, maturing in release.
sn46.21:2.6: They lead to enlightenment, bhikkhu, therefore they are called factors of enlightenment.”
